import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const userStore = readFileSync(new URL('../../../src/store/modules/user.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
const mutation = userStore.match(/SET_RESET_PASSWORD\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\n\s*\}/)

assert.ok(mutation, 'password reset mutation must exist')
assert.doesNotMatch(mutation[1], /console\.(?:log|info|debug)\s*\(/, 'password reset mutation must not log Vuex state or credentials')
console.log('password reset log safety check passed')
